publish.name: openstrike
publish.title: OpenStrikeRT
publish.summary: A path-traced team shooter: open it and you are in a match. Two teams, three lanes, every light traced.
publish.controls: W A S D move · Shift sprint · C crouch · Space jump · mouse aim, left fire, right sights · R reload · 1 2 3 or wheel: weapons · Tab scores
